description_en: Queries the domain ownership verification content of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-verify-content --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --domain-name example.com --access-origin share --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVerifyContent

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name that you want to query for ownership verification content
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The source of the domain name. Valid values:

- **share**: The domain name is added to WAF in CNAME record mode.

- **asset**: The domain name is added to WAF as a custom asset.

- **hybrid\_cloud\_cname**: The domain name is added to WAF in hybrid cloud CNAME record mode.

- **tgw**: The domain name is added to WAF in cloud native mode
parameters.help_zh:
接入来源。取值：

- **share**：表示公共云CNAME接入。

- **asset**：表示自定义资产接入。

- **hybrid_cloud_cname**：表示混合云CNAME接入。

- **tgw**：表示云产品接入
parameters.name: access_origin
